project_summary.name: User Authentication System
project_summary.description: A secure user authentication system with registration, login, JWT token management, and role-based access control, built with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.
project_summary.target_users: Application developers integrating authentication into their services
business_goals: Provide secure user registration and login
Ensure high test coverage and security

functional_requirements.name: User Registration
functional_requirements.description: Allow a new user to register with email and password. Password must be hashed with bcrypt before storage.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: User can register with a valid email and password (min 8 chars, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit).
AC2: Duplicate email registration returns error 409.
AC3: Password is stored as bcrypt hash with work factor >= 12.
AC4: On success, returns 201 with user ID and email.

functional_requirements.name: User Login
functional_requirements.description: Authenticate user with email and password, return JWT access token and refresh token.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Valid credentials return 200 with access token (expiry 15 min) and refresh token (expiry 7 days).
AC2: Invalid email or password returns 401.

functional_requirements.name: Password Encryption with bcrypt
functional_requirements.description: All passwords must be hashed using bcrypt with a work factor of at least 12 before storage.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Password hash is generated using bcrypt with work factor >= 12.
AC2: Plaintext password is never stored or logged.

functional_requirements.name: Token Refresh
functional_requirements.description: Allow users to obtain a new access token using a valid refresh token.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Valid refresh token returns 200 with new access token and optionally new refresh token (rotation).
AC2: Expired or revoked refresh token returns 401.
AC3: Refresh token is stored in database and can be revoked.

functional_requirements.name: Role-Based Access Control
functional_requirements.description: Define roles (e.g., admin, user) and assign them to users. Protect endpoints based on role.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Admin can create, read, update, delete roles.
AC2: Admin can assign a role to a user.
AC3: Endpoints can be decorated with required role; unauthorized roles return 403.

nonfunctional_requirements.name: Security Vulnerability Protection
nonfunctional_requirements.description: The system must protect against common vulnerabilities: SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, and broken authentication.
nonfunctional_requirements.target_metric: Zero critical or high severity vulnerabilities in OWASP Top 10 scan.

nonfunctional_requirements.name: Test Coverage
nonfunctional_requirements.description: The system must have comprehensive automated tests covering all functional requirements.
nonfunctional_requirements.target_metric: Code coverage >= 90% for unit and integration tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.name: Database Model Design
nonfunctional_requirements.description: Database models must be designed with proper relationships, indexes, and migrations using Alembic.
nonfunctional_requirements.target_metric: All tables have primary keys, foreign keys with indexes, and migration scripts are versioned.

nonfunctional_requirements.name: API Response Time
nonfunctional_requirements.description: API endpoints should respond quickly under normal load.
nonfunctional_requirements.target_metric: 95th percentile response time < 500ms for authentication endpoints.

nonfunctional_requirements.name: Error Messages
nonfunctional_requirements.description: Error responses should be clear and consistent, using standard HTTP status codes and JSON format.
nonfunctional_requirements.target_metric: All error responses include 'detail' field with human-readable message.

use_cases.name: Register New User
main_flow: 1. User submits registration form with email and password.
2. System validates email format and password strength.
3. System checks if email already exists; if so, return error.
4. System hashes password with bcrypt (work factor 12).
5. System creates new User record with role 'user' and is_active=true.
6. System returns 201 with user ID and email.

flow: 2b. System returns 400 with password policy error.

postconditions: User account is created and stored in database.
Password is hashed and never stored in plaintext.
business_rules: Password must be at least 8 characters, contain uppercase, lowercase, and digit.

use_cases.name: User Login
main_flow: 1. User submits email and password.
2. System looks up user by email.
3. If user not found, return 401.
4. System verifies password against stored bcrypt hash.
5. If password invalid, return 401.
6. If user account is inactive, return 403.
7. System generates JWT access token (15 min expiry) and refresh token (7 days expiry).
8. System stores refresh token in database.
9. System returns 200 with tokens.
postconditions: Refresh token is stored in database.

use_cases.name: Refresh Access Token
preconditions: User has a valid refresh token.
main_flow: 1. User sends refresh token to /refresh endpoint.
2. System validates refresh token (exists, not expired, not revoked).
3. If invalid, return 401.
4. System generates new access token (15 min expiry).
5. Optionally, system rotates refresh token (issue new, revoke old).
6. System returns 200 with new access token (and optionally new refresh token).
postconditions: Old refresh token may be revoked if rotation is implemented.
business_rules: Refresh token rotation is recommended for security.

use_cases.name: Manage Roles (Admin)
main_flow: 1. Admin sends request to create/update/delete role.
2. System validates admin permissions.
3. System performs CRUD operation on Role table.
4. System returns appropriate response (201, 200, 204).

constraints.description: Must use Python 3.9+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and pytest.
Development database: SQLite; Production database: PostgreSQL.
Authentication must use JWT (access token) and bcrypt for password hashing.
System must support at least 1000 concurrent users.

risk_assessment.risk: Insecure password storage due to misconfiguration of bcrypt work factor.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Enforce work factor >= 12 in code and configuration; code review.
risk_assessment.contingency: Audit and rotate all passwords if breach detected.

risk_assessment.risk: JWT token theft leading to unauthorized access.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Use short-lived access tokens (15 min) and refresh token rotation; store refresh tokens securely (HTTP-only cookies).
risk_assessment.contingency: Implement token revocation list and force re-login.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Use SQLAlchemy ORM with parameterized queries; avoid raw SQL.
risk_assessment.contingency: Run regular security scans and penetration tests.

risk_assessment.risk: Insufficient test coverage leading to undetected bugs.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Enforce minimum 90% coverage; include unit, integration, and security tests.
risk_assessment.contingency: Add automated CI pipeline to fail on coverage drop.

assumptions: Email service for verification is out of scope.
User roles are predefined (admin, user) and can be extended.
Token revocation is handled via database blacklist or refresh token deletion.

security_requirements.description: All API endpoints must require valid JWT authentication except registration and login.
security_requirements.target_metric: 0 unauthenticated requests succeed on protected endpoints.

security_requirements.description: All passwords hashed with bcrypt (work factor >= 12).
security_requirements.target_metric: No plaintext passwords in storage or logs.

security_requirements.description: Validate and sanitize all user inputs; use parameterized queries.
Implement role-based access control; endpoints check user role.

observability_requirements.description: Structured JSON logging with request_id propagation.
observability_requirements.target_metric: Every request has traceable log entries from entry to exit.
Response within 1 second, includes DB status.

observability_requirements.description: Prometheus metrics: request count, latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate.
